experiments.purpose: Make the 伯爵 conversation a return-worthy free experience before asking for commerce.
experiments.hypothesis: An optional feedback prompt after five turns can provide a revisit-intent signal without turning a refusal into a sales prompt.
experiments.target: Visitors who voluntarily reach five chat turns; no traffic or human sample has yet been observed.
experiments.change: Use the implemented optional post-five-turn feedback surface; keep free conversation separate from verified commerce facts.
experiments.primaryMetric: Optional post-five-turn feedback: revisit or neutral
experiments.safetyMetric: Explicit sales opt-out stops commercial CTA. No-current-purchase intent permits paced contextual value after conversation, not compulsory or repeated pitches. Honor no-link/no-button and no-search instructions; never invent product facts.
experiments.result: Raw Day0 has one 5+ turn conversation and three recommendations, explicitly confirmed by owner as self-QA. Eligible external observed Chat starts/3+/5+/recommendations remain0; independent-human sample unknown.
experiments.next: Observe only after voluntary external use; use the lightweight blinded review separately for naturalness, trust and understanding.
